bookingSuccess.step1: Arrive at the station 5 minutes before your time slot.
bookingSuccess.step2: Open the app, select "Scan QR" and scan the code on the charger.
bookingSuccess.step3: Plug in the charging cable and start the session from the app.
bookingSuccess.refundNote: 100% refund policy applies if cancelled 30 minutes ahead.

bookingDetail.title: Booking details
bookingDetail.countdownNote: Please arrive on time and scan the QR code on the charger to start your session. The booking auto-cancels if you are more than 15 minutes late.
bookingDetail.refundBody: 100% refund if cancelled more than 60 minutes ahead, 50% within 15–60 minutes, and no refund under 15 minutes before the start time.
bookingDetail.refundedNote: Cancelled. {{amount}} refunded to your ChargeOps Wallet.
bookingDetail.holdNote: Your time is held for {{time}} more. Finish payment before it runs out or the range is released.

cancelBooking.title: Confirm cancellation
cancelBooking.subtitle: Please review the refund policy carefully before continuing.
cancelBooking.policyFull: You're cancelling early (more than 60 minutes before the start). You get a full 100% refund.
cancelBooking.policyPartial: You're cancelling within 1 hour of the start time. A 50% service fee is withheld per platform policy.
cancelBooking.policyNone: You're cancelling under 15 minutes before the start. No refund applies to this cancellation.
cancelBooking.walletNote: Funds will be returned to your ChargeOps Wallet within 2-3 minutes.
cancelBooking.warning: Cancelling too often may affect your reputation score on ChargeOps.
cancelBooking.policyGrace: You're within 5 minutes of booking — cancelling now refunds everything, however close the start time is.
